subject: *: fix query reports ScalarFunction is not supported in batch mode (#55074)
summary: Planner IndexMerge: split partial index-scan filters into TiKV-pushable vs remaining (using `extractFiltersForIndexMerge`), collect remaining filters from partial index scans and the table side, and attach them to `CopTask.rootTaskConds` so non-TiKV-pushable scalar functions (e.g. `FORMAT`) are evaluated in TiDB instead of being pushed into TiKV cop/batch. Adds an integrationtest `EXPLAIN` case for #55012 validating the resulting plan shape (root Selection above IndexMerge).
